notes.title: Construction Mode Update is Live!
notes.content:
Hey, Fountain Seekers!

We're excited to share some thrilling news with you on this nice Wednesday. [b]Survival: Fountain of Youth’s experience continues to evolve[/b] with a free update to increase the amount of fun and creativity our awesome community can have.

So, we thought it would be cool to give you the chance to experience the game as you've never been able to before. You know, cutting time on some tedious processes and letting your imagination truly shine. In other words, please welcome the [b]free construction mode with unlimited possibilities[/b]!

[i]The Construction Mode on consoles is coming soon, too![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/df49774900c0fd0fbfc337568d6e10445e3f2d18.jpg[/img]
So, how about building the greatest constructions imaginable in SFOY? Maybe an Eiffel Tower or a replica of some old fancy castle. Or something that has never been built before. Let your imagination shine.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/62cbefa6ed161963ae85b070d89f8fac6650b9dc.png[/img]

And now, to the details!

You can choose the [b]Construction mode right from the main menu[/b]. What does this new mode mean?
[list]
[*] Unlimited crafting and building. All recipes are unlocked.
[*] All locations are open and ready to be settled
[*] Animals don’t notice the player. 
[*] No negative statuses.
[*] Immortality and flight mode (double jump to activate)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/d3657ee6ea31604a17d01f83254a04a2f086fd68.jpg[/img]
This mode has no character development and no story progress. All game content will become available immediately, so keep it in mind if you are a new player. In that case, we recommend playing the game in normal mode first.

Also, please note that the game performance may be affected if too many objects are created in your save.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/c1be57a4d455feba229466b1d0366cc4c509acbd.jpg[/img]
A [b]huge round of applause[/b] to everyone who has supported our project to this day! The game was released in Early Access over two years ago, and it's been a wonderful experience of both developing a game and interacting with our awesome players. So, we hope this update will let you explore your freedom and show off your creativity in Survival: Fountain of Youth.

And if you don’t already own a copy of Survival: Fountain of Youth, it’s time to get it with a nice [b]60% discount till May 28[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/62cbefa6ed161963ae85b070d89f8fac6650b9dc.png[/img]

Time to rejoice and immerse yourself in this new mode! And please be sure to share your creations on Steam screenshots and/or [url=https://x.com/survival_foy]X[/url] using the [i]#creativeSFOY[/i] hashtag. A fine hashtag to accompany some fantastic constructions, which we can’t wait to see!

[i]The Survival: Fountain of Youth Team  [/i]

notes.title: Survival: Fountain of Youth 1.0 OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Greetings, Fountain Seekers!

The time has finally come and today we invite you to continue your adventures in the last story chapter of the game! The official release of Survival: Fountain of Youth also marks the final steps of development for our team. It has been a great honor and a lot of excitement to work on the game and to share development steps with you since the playtest stage in 2022. 

And for those new to the game — welcome to experience the full journey in search of the Fountain of Youth!

[i]Set sail, brave sailor! The sea is calling![/i]

[previewyoutube=tKfqAVbJvnI;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/62cbefa6ed161963ae85b070d89f8fac6650b9dc.png[/img]
[h3]BIMINI[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/53200f574e012342013e9541cba536a7f233c6bb.png[/img]
If you checked our latest [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1967630/view/4203623929273488764?l=english]Dev Diary on Bimini[/url], you know where to head for your final challenge. You may sail there on your Stormbreaker and use the Natives’ path or repair [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1967630/view/4172096195388598732?l=english]the Ark ship[/url] in the bay of the Silver Island, build a cannon on its bow, and break your way to Bimini Island through the rocks. 

In any case, bring your best gear and weapons because landing on Bimini Island is only the beginning of your final trial. We won’t spoil the details though. 

[h3]CUSTOM DIFFICULTY SETTINGS[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/b843065dfe7972ef96c93f5ded9c5473b67564e5.png[/img]
One of the features you’ve been asking us for has finally arrived! Before starting a new game, you may tweak a number of settings to your liking no matter what initial game difficulty you choose. Whether you want to play on Survivor but with increased resources and less stamina drain or prefer more relaxed gameplay on Tourist but with increased animal difficulty — it’s your choice!

[h3]IRON SET OF EQUIPMENT[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/1827b38901e65b1743379e01caeffc8fd1faa400.png[/img]
Suit up! If you have a linen set of equipment and some iron ingots in store, it's finally time to craft the most powerful armor in the game providing you with 64 (in total) armor points (besides protection from all kinds of weather and decreased damage from animals). And don't forget to pack this set for your final journey!

[h3]TIER 5 SURVIVAL ABILITIES, NEW SURVIVAL TASKS AND SKILL BOOKS[/h3]

Your character has never been so powerful: complete new survival tasks, level up your favorite survival abilities to the maximum, and find new books for improving your skills!   

[h3]NEW ANIMALS, RESOURCES AND BLUEPRINTS [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/2bdb0ebdff26a5aea2034a1e7d339c38aaac1ff9.jpg[/img]
On your way to the temple on Bimini Island, you’ll find new animal species, including cute Armadillos, not-so-cute Black Boars, and pretty scary Black Panthers. And what do new animals mean? Right, new resources and crafting blueprints, namely top-tier Armadillo Shell Mortar and Stone Skin Potion to increase your armor temporarily. And of course, new trophies and hides for your house!

[h3]BOMBS[/h3]

KA-BOOM! We’ve added a new type of deadly weapon — bombs dealing damage to everyone within the explosion range (yes, including you). And while a standard Bomb has a delay before exploding to let you run to a safe distance, an Improved Bomb detonates right on the spot. Keep that in mind. 

[h3]BALANCE IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]

We’ve added quite a lot of content for the past year, so it was time to balance some issues, namely:
[list][*] Provided the opportunity to craft seeds. After you unlock this ability with a farming skill book, seeds can be crafted on the Improved Chemistry Workbench, using 2-3 fruit and fertilizer. 
[*] Reduced the amount of meat in animals (except for the Island of Hope)
[*] Added food level decrease in flu statuses (Puma and Snake regions)
[*] Increased the number of bullet and shot charges produced from one Iron Ingot from 5 to 8
[*] Removed fish bones from Dorado (they can now only be obtained from fish in fish spots)
[*] Added fish bones to one of the medicine recipes instead of salt.
[*] Slightly increased the nutritional value of fish compared to meat.[/list]
[h3]NEW LOCALIZATIONS[/h3]

We’ve also added a bunch of new languages (Brazilian-Portuguese, Korean, and Traditional Chinese) so that more players around the world can play the game in their native language.  

[h3]IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]
[list][*] Tired of constantly pressing W? The autowalk feature is now at your service! Just press G when walking/sailing/swimming!
[*] The map filter is back! It is easier now to sort map markers by different types.
[*] Standard Water Distiller is so last century. If you already have access to copper, an Improved Water Distiller that produces twice the amount of clean water is your choice! 
[*] New golden decorations. Your interiors have never been so shiny! 
[*] After you complete all survival tasks, start collecting survival points for the days you’ve spent in the game! Reworked statistics tab in Journal now showing your overall game progress (+ other improvements). 
[*] Prepare to experience a new type of weather in the Puma and Snake regions — storms! Hopefully, you all are already experienced sailors... 
[*] You will now receive 1 additional survival point if you meet all conditions for unlocking each region! 
[*] Watch where you’re heading — sails become transparent when you take the helm.    
[*] And, of course, new Steam achievements! 
[*] Better performance.[/list]
[h3]BUGFIXES[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed rays and jellyfish near the Galeon in the Snake region
[*] Fixed grass issues and terrain textures on the Island of Hope 
[*] Fixed first-tier columns on which it was impossible to place floor
[*] Fixed canoe control viewpoint
[*] Fixed the issue when it was impossible to build machines under wall decorations
[*] Fixed the possibility of using a torch underwater
[*] Fixed some environmental materials
[*] Fixed map markers on info objects
[*] Fixed house columns collider
[*] Fixed the delay for firearm projectile
[*] Multiple visual fixes
[*] Multiple localization fixes[/list]
And now, before you dive into the compelling world of Survival: Fountain of Youth, please remember that your feedback, comments, and reviews will help us make the game even better. So, feel free to share your thoughts in Steam discussions, on our [url=http://discord.gg/G6WgWMSa3U]official Discord server[/url], or via support@odinsoft.com.


[i]The Survival: Fountain of Youth Team[/i]

notes.title: Dev Diary | Bimini
notes.content:
Greetings, Fountain Seekers!

Welcome to the point of your destination, the hidden and mysterious isle of Bimini, located behind the stormy belt! The faith of your crew and the existence of the Fountain of Youth — soon you will finally have the answers to all your questions. Make sure you are well prepared for the final challenge so none of the past trials will be in vain. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/bf612a92bb315a74d2aaa9eae719d3737d2a543d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/62cbefa6ed161963ae85b070d89f8fac6650b9dc.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/5d3afe7b8c25f48eaa81b17394bbf2a5f90ecdd9.png[/img]
As the search parties figured, the Bimini belt is protected by a chain of rocks, strong unfavorable winds, and dangerous currents. But since the Natives managed to pass it on their Stormbreaker ships, you should be able to break the way by taking the Natives’ path.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/02a1344e25da529b3ab85c77af1eb34c2a586beb.png[/img]
Or you can build an even stronger ship and literally break your way with cannonballs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/2635187f20ee2b9d17fd02e952108bc5b16a44e9.png[/img]
Once you pass the Bimini belt you will reach the vast and prosperous island of Bimini — a mythical place covered in jungle and thick fog hiding its mysteries and valuable resources. 

Only a few steps — and you’re at the top of the world (well, at the top of Bimini Island, at least)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/6f7615d3032b3f378f4af401ce2b1a973d8215b1.png[/img]
The island is crowned by a huge pyramid temple, with several ways leading to it through the jungle, covered with this mystical-looking fog. Looks so peaceful, isn’t it? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/95ff238a414001924e65fc38134285a646f053b3.png[/img]
If you are willing to find the Fountain, look for the clues. It is also inevitable that these clues will be protected. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/c2461570a1946c69b4809b99889a24b3ff2c2acf.png[/img]
Reaching the temple is not enough though. Hopefully you’re fully prepared for what is waiting for you there! You must ensure you are ready for this trial and do not hesitate to step back if you don’t feel strong enough. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/7a5d46c812c061d7f0a99ba00ed53c53cd50a95c.png[/img]
Let the final challenge begin!

[i]The Survival: Fountain of Youth Team[/i]

notes.title: Patch 1587 | Improved Saving System, New Tutorial, and More
notes.content:
Greetings, Fountain Seekers!

We are making the [b]final steps in our Early Access adventure[/b] and here goes the patch that will smooth up our way there. Be prepared and enjoy the changes we've made.

The biggest change is the improvement to the saving system, and we're particularly interested in hearing your thoughts on it. There is also a new tutorial, more house customization recipes, the ability to craft using items from nearby containers... 

So, while you're updating the game, it's time to look at this patch in more detail. Shall we?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/62cbefa6ed161963ae85b070d89f8fac6650b9dc.png[/img]
[h3]IMPROVED SAVING SYSTEM[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/a30c16067a0775cb48b9a4a7f0bfd6f8fdff8f75.png[/img]
The long-awaited improvements to the saving system have come! There are up to [b]four profiles[/b] as separate games you can simultaneously play with each one having [b]10 saving slots[/b]. You can save and load them on demand (except for the Iron Man mode).

[h3]NEW TUTORIAL[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/22c1a4da5f42979e9353fa889489ea871face0ac.png[/img]
With the game having developed so far, we felt that the existing tutorial should be improved. We’ve studied a lot of your feedback to make onboarding more intuitive and player-friendly. 

The new tutorial sequence includes a small island within which a new player learns all basic game mechanics before heading to the Island of Hope. There are new quests and various changes so that players’ exploration of the Bird region is more enjoyable and that the learning curve is not so steep anymore. 

Hopefully, these changes are all for the better. Looking forward to your feedback and comments!

[h3]IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]More decor blueprints![/b] The list includes chairs (and the ability to sit on them) + a table, a bench, and a stool, as well as several items from Santiago: a wall anchor, a captain's plate, and ship paddles.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/3174a87aec586fee67ddb727bb21398da44d5147.png[/img]
[*] Now you can use items not only from your Inventory but also from containers nearby. It works for crafting, building, repairing, installing traps, and farming. Less leg work, more arm work! 
[*] One more resource management improvement! When interacting with a container, you can now move all stacks of duplicate items with one button (stacks that are both in the inventory and the container).
[*] Optimized physics of objects and surfaces’ behavior for better performance.
[/list]
[h3]FIXES[/h3]
[list][*] Added the possibility of not using tinder during the ignition process
[*] Changed the color of the wood material (now houses and some machines will look a little different)
[*] Added a ‘News’ window in the main menu of the game. Because there will be news!
[*] Fixed mines’ holes on the Island of Hope
[*] Fixed the scroll button visibility 
[*] Fixed animal outlines in Concentration mode
[*] Improved the disclaimer during the game launch
[*] Changed how goals are displayed: when all mandatory steps in a group are completed, the next group is activated and shown in HUD (so quests with optional steps work correctly)
[*] Bird Potion balance fix
[*] Fixed the barrel on the Lonely Rock
[*] Localization changes
[*] Multiple visual fixes [/list]
[h3]SEA WOLF PACK[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/7f34ce4f70623f190f6f031cf0b9ae07578e41a8.png[/img]
We're happy to announce that the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2866210/Survival_Fountain_of_Youth_Sea_Wolf_Pack/]Sea Wolf Pack DLC is out and available for purchase[/url]! It’s a set of cosmetic items for your home for those who want to elevate the naval theme in their homes. 

The Sea Wolf pack contains [b]8 blueprints of various maritime items[/b]:
[list][*] a ship’s bell that will ring when poked around. 
[*] an anchor to place on the floor of your home. 
[*] a ship’s helm to be placed on any wall you want. 
[*] a spinning globe from the 16th century with the known coast at the time. 
[*] a scaled model of Santiago.
[*] two historical maps of the New World, the map of Piri Reis and the map of Juan de la Cosa to display on walls.
[*] a Captain’s Hat with nice bonuses including +100% protection from the sun, +25% protection from the wind, cold, and rain; +5 armor; -5% wound chance and decreasing poison chance.[/list]
With the release of this pack, we want to provide you with the option of additional customization of your houses. We hope you'll enjoy this new DLC, as it would also be very helpful for the game development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/62cbefa6ed161963ae85b070d89f8fac6650b9dc.png[/img]

Alright, that's enough for now - but not for today, as [b]a bit later we're announcing the full release date[/b] (finally)!

Have a great week, enjoy the update, and stay tuned for more news!

[i]The Survival: Fountain of Youth Team[/i]

notes.title: Dev Diary | Da Vinci's Ark
notes.content:
Greetings, Fountain Seekers!

As the release of the final story chapter is getting closer, it’s time to show you something we’ve been working on. Has anyone asked for a huge ship on which you can build a full base? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/62cbefa6ed161963ae85b070d89f8fac6650b9dc.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/c46ec1032d1d0b1bc37019ad7f0fbaf9151a3325.png[/img]
We want to introduce you to a new top-tier sea vessel you’ll be able to obtain in the late game. Please meet the Ark ship — a marvel of naval design supposedly made by the schemes of a legendary inventor Leonardo da Vinci.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/be1cc1ffe46b72fb999726753229b618bbf9843a.png[/img]
An exceptional construction allows this vessel to be controlled even by a single experienced sailor, making it a fantastic choice for a lone survivor and an avid explorer. 

It is a fast, sturdy, and reliable ship. However, its main advantage over any existing sea vessel in the game is the number of crafting machines that can be installed in it. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/13f2f339348d4e7a9489f753a310dc6ff74805bc.png[/img]
The upper deck is equipped with an exceptional storage space with several log storages, a large container, and a comfortable bed to sleep in the fresh air. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/de6cec0aee16ff664aa235e7a91450a6a5b1198d.png[/img]
It also includes an important tool for underwater exploration — a winch serving for uplifting items from the sea bed that will play an important role in the final story chapter and exploration.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/ad1e2b122319207d33d9f4748c9fa998162ff202.png[/img]
At the bow of the ship, the Ark has a large caliber cannon (a place to install it, to be exact). No, there will be no enemies attacking your ship, but it will be necessary to move forward through the story. We won’t be releasing any spoilers just yet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/bec1f45c908acce16bbcf7aa72b34079b7f6c9ff.png[/img]
The cargo hold is another exciting feature as it not only provides spacious storage space but also allows you to build any structures or machines you want (limited by the size of this area). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/4fc936ef90521c63e50b417a7be06bf59a80358a.png[/img]
A true definition of a floating base that you can arrange to your liking, have everything you need for travels, and make every place feel like home. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/0aa80edcb54deb635c6b2a34999a41ad6ba8827f.png[/img]
The Ark will become available with the last content update/full release, which date is going to be announced very soon. So stay tuned, dear Fountain Seekers, and prepare for the final challenges!

[i]The Survival: Fountain of Youth Team[/i]

notes.title: Reaping the Harvest Update | Snake Region, Farms, Stormbreaker, and More
notes.content:
Hello, Fountain Seekers!

This is it! We are thrilled to celebrate the release of the [b]Reaping the Harvest update[/b] with a whole new region and lots of new features and improvements. Hope you are ready to set sail and head to new uncharted lands!

[i]But this is no ordinary expedition…

Lush mangrove forests, expansive malaria swamps, breathtaking sulfur valleys, and vast fields with bright autumn grass - the natural beauty and inherent challenges of the Snake region will create an experience unlike any other. [/i]

[previewyoutube=3sLsRuso6lI;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/62cbefa6ed161963ae85b070d89f8fac6650b9dc.png[/img]
[h2]Snake Region[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/f8021fb743c687a470f7ddf699b9b8ecf992ed99.png[/img]
Here, vast territories that once were home to the Snake tribe sprawl beneath the skies. As you venture deep into these lands, prepare to battle not only new predators but also mighty forces of nature: chilling cold, howling winds, and heavy rains. Protection from malaria and sulfur gas will also come in handy. 

Be prepared to confront new predators. Condors may or may not attack you, but they’ll definitely attack if there is a dead animal nearby. Sharp-toothed caimans will attack you regardless, once you set foot on their beloved swamps. Hammerhead sharks will push you to the sea bottom… So, a lot of new friendly creatures are waiting to meet you!

Sulfur deposits and Silver mines are essential for crafting firearms, but we also added Iron and Copper mines to the new region, as there is always a need for (m)ore.     

[h2]Farming[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/0b6f699ed2a6eb3ebd1bae6d6d357427425c79c9.png[/img]
Hope you have checked our recent [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1967630/view/3809543111546035795]Dev Diary post on Farms[/url] and already have your shovels prepared - those lush gardens won't cultivate themselves! By the way, with farming, we've also added several new plants to diversify your menu and wardrobe: Linen, Corn, Pumpkin, Tomato, Pepper, and Vanilla.

[h2]Firearms[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/617466447aa9625839f98ff9a5af873ed25cad87.png[/img]
It's time to stop running around with spears and arrows like a savage as we finally fully introduced firearms to the game. Requiring quite a number of resources, pistols, musketoons, and flintlock guns are ready to protect you from the dangers of the Snake region. Recharging takes some time though, just keep it in mind. 

[h2]Stormbreaker[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/a46889442366860384c86a8e0204d9b211561b7b.png[/img]
The legendary ship that Natives used to reach Bimini Island is now in the game. Complete Shaman's side quest line to get the precious blueprint and craft this new addition to the ships’ collection!

Apart from the usual stuff, Stormbreaker also has useful crafting machines on board (adding with each tier): primitive barrel (tier 1), clay rainwater collector (tier 2), improved smelter (tier 3), and advanced chemistry workbench (tier 4). 

In one of the future updates, we’ll also add storms to the game, which Stormbreakers will be immune to. What a ship to sail!

[h2]New equipment sets[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/e45e60a9d083a19feccc55406edfb8e1ed14cdd6.png[/img]
In the Snake region, you will be able to make two new equipment sets to show off in front of the local animals. Collect flax, make linen fabric, and craft the Linen set, which will be essential to battle cold. 

If you are attentive enough when exploring the new region, you’ll be able to learn how to craft the Hunter set. Made with rabbit leather, it increases protection from the sun and rain. When the full set is equipped, you receive a special status that makes you less noticeable to animals and reduces stamina costs. 

[h2]More books to unlock new skill effects[/h2]

It’s so nice to become smarter! Collect and read books to unlock new skill effects and help with your everyday survival. 

[h2]New content/Improvements[/h2]
[list][*] New decorative items you’ve been asking for, including Weapon Rack, Log Storage, Twig Storage, and new animal trophies. It’s still far from furnished IKEA rooms, but we’re determined to make your houses more and more cozy with each update. 
[*] New machines for crafting: Excellent Workbench, Excellent Forge, and Compost Pit. 
[*] Improved dock! The basic dock was fine for mooring rafts and canoes, but schooners and Stormbreaker require something more presentable. The improved dock has a roof and increases fast travel speed. 
[*] Paralyzing arrows. These are arrows soaked in paralytic poison that paralyzes the victim for a short time (so you can bravely run away!).   
[*] New potions: Pinole to temporarily increase weight limit, Diligence Potion that temporarily reduces the time needed for processes, and Heating Ointment to help spend those long cold evenings... 
[*] More survival tasks - more survival points! We know there are always some useful abilities to level up. [/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list][*] Finally fixed the grass growing through the floor. 
[*] Fixed the bug with progress bars freezing.
[*] Fixed the bug with animal skeletons not disappearing in traps.
[*] Fixed the bug with some objects becoming very dark in the shadows.
[*] Fixed game crashes for some players.
[*] Fixed the bug with the ship not automatically mooring to the dock when traveling between regions.
[*] Fixed the bug with not being able to place trophies in inventory.
[*] Fixed the bug with buildings sticking out through the Tier 2 floor.
[*] Fixed the bug with Great Spanish Schooner not being able to dock, if there is a log in the rear Log Storage.
[*] Multiple minor bug fixes.[/list]
[h3]Important notes[/h3]

As we tried to release the new region in time, there may be several lines that are missing localization in various languages (English text will however be provided). It is a known issue, and will be fixed in one of the upcoming hotfixes!


Before we let you go on with your journey, we want to thank you for supporting us and contributing to the game’s development. Hopefully, your experience in the new region will be as enjoyable and smooth as possible, but if you encounter any issues, please feel free to let us know!

Let the adventure begin now!

[i]The Survival: Fountain of Youth Team[/i]

notes.title: Dev Diary | Farms
notes.content:
Greetings, Fountain Seekers!

Well, trees are already regrowing in Survival: Fountain of Youth, and we decided to develop this idea even further, especially since the more activities there are to do, the better. So…

[b]Prepare to reap the harvest! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/12003b27f980999cca31c6a26162122d9c37f8b9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/62cbefa6ed161963ae85b070d89f8fac6650b9dc.png[/img]
[h3]NEW ITEMS: SEEDS[/h3]

How to get seeds? When you gather resources from certain plants or trees, there is a certain chance to also receive this nice-looking bag with seeds. Well, we know they don't naturally come in bags, but let's be honest, they’re much easier to sort out this way! 

You will be able to grow many different plants that are already familiar to you, along with some new ones (around 20 in total).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/9994227db1fe227d49dff7f2d5e6ee5f19dae3e9.png[/img]
[h3]NEW MACHINE: FARM[/h3]

Obtaining seeds is only the first step. Some logs and a shovel - and you’ll be able to build a farm with six slots to grow your plants. There are three tiers - basic, improved, and excellent - with water tanks of various volumes and different times for plant growth.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/44665ba87c51e11f854bfa660c48bc14f82fa20b.png[/img]
[h3]WATERING AND FERTILIZING[/h3]

Experienced farmers know that water is the main thing a plant needs to grow. Clean water, to be exact. Good news: farms automatically collect water when it’s raining. So, it's up to you whether to build more water collectors or learn some rain-summoning dance. 

For already-grown plants, you can use fertilizers. Fertilizers are made of rotten food in a compost pit - another new machine type. Increasing the speed of fruit/flower/leaf growth + utilizing some of that rotten food = win-win!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/68d9ce4d4dfa6686e05e0b47406562cd6b0ee85a.png[/img]
[h3]NEW SKILLS: FARMING[/h3]

Growing plants levels up your new skill - farming. It will give you some nice perks: reducing the time it takes to grow a plant, speeding up the resource recovery in plants on a farm, higher chance of collecting seeds from plants on a farm, etc. 

And be ready to grow a garden your grandmother will be jealous of!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/2b97f246d22015ff033120d56b5679aeb685adbd.png[/img]

New autumn plants for your cozy screenshots! Can’t carve it though, but maybe in the future…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/8f907bd72d3d2ce2fa65ae17bad4d19cc97e7cd9.png[/img]

While you were reading our guide on farms, the Snake region release date moved a bit closer! It will be announced next week, so prepare your shovels, and if you have any questions about farms, the upcoming update, our plans, or basically anything, please bring them in the comments!

[i]The Survival: Fountain of Youth Team[/i]

notes.title: Dev Diary | Snake Region Sneak Peek
notes.content:
Dear Fountain Seekers!

The story of a 16th-century sailor searching for his crewmates and, if lucky, a magical spring, continues. The 4th story chapter is getting close to its release! While a lot of it is still being actively developed, we've reached a stage where we can shed some light on what is waiting for you in the upcoming content update. Let us give you a brief tour of this next part of the map in the Survival: Fountain of Youth world. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/4287a1d14be7bce06c29aa59d10d74a211d4f15a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/15aafa495f77f09e28a0c97cfccd2650591011fb.png[/img]

So, some facts about the [b]Snake region[/b]. It got its name (no, not from the abundance of those crawling creatures) from the Snake tribe that lived here a long time ago. They were skilled healers who gathered herbs and prepared remedies against the most terrible wounds and diseases. 

The Snake region will introduce you to a new set of challenging conditions to survive in. Be ready to deal with piercing colds, new dangerous predators, diseases, and story twists.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/3086575be9d650d3cdd5d03ca8443aa10b0b727a.png[/img]

Silver Island will remind you of the Island of Hope due to its size. It’s a large island with rocks to climb, spreading meadows, multi-level plateaus, and plenty of places where you can build a large base (or several, no restrictions here!). Be careful though, new animal predators are lurking between those rocks...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/5e7904b841ee5bf15f72a4e61941b3c629f53a2e.png[/img]

Would you like a house with this view?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/9cb98bc0ff9c892ae6f9915714dd36ade6408181.png[/img]

As you may know from your previous adventures, the Engineer and the Doctor left for Sulfur Island to find resources for gunpowder. Will you meet them there? Time will tell. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/b1208b45250b04f3653f7158050b96f53bde9890.png[/img]

Although Sulfur Island doesn’t seem particularly hospitable, it’s an essential stop for everyone wishing to finally craft those firearms. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/433cd3a82d089a09e301f88b67e5366ae1238061.png[/img]

Well, now to Crocodile Island. Can you guess what its distinguishing feature is? A big part of it is occupied by crocodile-infested swamps. This territory is both resourceful and treacherous at the same time. Even though it serves as a great hunting spot and place to gather valuable plants, sharp-toothed crocodiles and malaria may make your stay on the island fatal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/3b1d7b47a78d798589bd60369d0c7bd586cd3e48.png[/img]

A mysterious Labyrinth lies on the further part of Crocodile Island. Tangled corridors of rocks conceal not only valuable objects but also dangerous challenges. One of them is to find your way back. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/e23fa16ae39cba02b3b097851e2acefc928538d1.png[/img]

As we wrap up for today, we're excited to see your comments and can't wait to share this content with you. Stay tuned for the next Dev Diary in which we'll tell you about farms - an important feature coming with the update.  
 
[i]The Survival: Fountain of Youth Team[/i]

notes.title: Patch 1433 | Trees Respawning, Game Optimization, and More
notes.content:
Greetings, Fountain Seekers!

Patch 1433 is ready to be downloaded! This time we bring you some long-awaited features —  yes, trees, finally! — as well as a whole bunch of improvements, changes, and bug fixes. 

As always, thank you for providing us with feedback and suggestions for the new update!

So, let’s jump into some details, shall we?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/62cbefa6ed161963ae85b070d89f8fac6650b9dc.png[/img]
[h3]NEW FEATURES AND IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]
[list][*] The number one requested feature is in the game — trees respawn now! Finally, you don’t have to choose between a big proper base and saving the ecology of the Survival: Fountain of Youth’s world. Just remember to leave a stump for the tree to regrow — and in a certain number of days, you’ll be able to chop it off once again! 
[*] Art assets/textures optimization. Can’t promise you’ll be able to launch the game on a calculator now, but as a result, players should experience reduced memory consumption, better game performance, and higher fps. Please note that some textures are not final yet, we'll continue polishing them, as we consider the visual part of the game as important as its performance.  
[*] Improved animals’ behavior and animations in battle. A bit more natural and less scripted, a bit more diverse, and a bit easier to control with a new red highlight before the attack (Animal Attack Indication — you can turn it off in Controls). 
[*] Improved Barrel which contains up to 60 units of liquid. Storing water is as important as gathering it!
[*] Animals’ carcasses now disappear over time. Just 3 days and you can say goodbye to your pet cemetery!
[*] Native support for Sony DualSense (PS5) and Sony DualShock 4 (PS4) controllers.[/list]
[h3]BUGFIXES[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed the visibility of the ignition failure. 
[*] Fixed long loading time when traveling from the first region to any other.
[*] Fixed the bug with a quiver disappearing when trying to equip it.
[*] Fixed the bug with a stingray getting stuck in the monolith and electrocuting when approaching it.
[*] Fixed several bugs with loading save slots.
[*] Fixed interactive objects that couldn’t be interacted with.
[*] Fixed the bug with Set of Tools counting as an inventory item until it is dropped and retaken.
[*] Fixed the bug when a character could catch the Burning Sun and Heat statuses while standing in the shadow.
[*] Visual improvements.
[*] Localization fixes.
[*] Multiple small fixes.[/list]
[h3]WHAT'S NEXT[/h3]
The Snake region is coming! It is being shaped, built, tuned, filled with features, and tested — and after today’s release, it has our full focus. While we can’t give you any specific dates or details just yet, we promise not to leave you in the dark and share our development news as we move closer and closer to day X! And we’ll definitely have some interesting things to share! 

[i]The Survival: Fountain of Youth Team[/i]

notes.title: Captain’s Trail Update | Puma Region, Iron, Second-Tier Housing, and More
notes.content:
Hello, Fountain Seekers!

Here is the Captain's Trail update with a whole range of new content, improvements, and bug fixes. So, grab your pickaxe, and a couple of coconuts for the road, and sail to the new lands!

[i]Hot steam bursting from the ground, chilling fog embracing old shipwrecks, occasional howls echoing off the rocks... 

Do you dare to venture into the Puma region and brave its challenges?[/i]

[previewyoutube=zhEn61bP3cU;full][/previewyoutube]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/62cbefa6ed161963ae85b070d89f8fac6650b9dc.png[/img]
[h2]Puma Region [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/0cb063576a121fcb57c782cae9a584201e29e2ab.png[/img]
Welcome to the Puma region! In these unfamiliar lands, mastering the knowledge of its conditions and inhabitants is essential if you want to survive. Strong wind chills to the bone and lowers the chances of igniting. Large pumas and fast bats only await to wound and poison every wanderer. Dangerous cliffs and shipwrecks trouble sailing between the islands. So, be ready to improvise, adapt, and overcome to unravel the story of your missing crew members!

[h2]Second-Tier Housing[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/5a652fbf75d9c952093f88182c5571fc8db07fdf.png[/img]
Be sure to gather as many Iron Tree Branches in the Puma region as possible, if you plan to upgrade your house. Second-tier houses are not only a joy to look at, but also provide Improved Home Comfort status and protection from cold compared to first-tier houses. Moreover, your body fights illnesses and your energy is restored faster when you're in it. One more thing: no holes in the walls, in case some creepy tortoise decides to watch you.

[h2]Spanish Schooner[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/eb8d45a6d50d9a125c25fa25d14e3d3996ba9d83.png[/img]
It is enough to build a schooner only for its looks, but it also has increased durability, speed, and storage containers compared to all other vessels. What is more, each schooner has a high mast that you can climb to observe and map the area for sea resources. 

Please note that schooners are significantly bigger compared to all other sea vessels in the game so far, so you may need to rebuild/move your docks a bit so it is possible to moor. 

[h2]Iron[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/a8ad1196ed52bf6b44879f18f157f52bd738406c.png[/img]
Copper is no longer the highest-tier material in the game. Use iron ingots to craft the sturdiest tools, equipment, and that nice-looking schooner you saw above. Further adventures call for upgrades!

[h2]Great Jackal [/h2]

A new challenge that may make you finally use that block feature from the tutorial - Great Jackal. It is the first boss in the game, with minions and a fearsome arena decorated with huge bones. Be sure to bring all your best equipment and weapons there! 

What is the best in every boss fight? That’s right, the prize. After killing Great Jackal, in its carcass, you’ll find a key (those predators would eat literally anything!) to the chest with Macuahuitl, the elite Natives' melee weapon. You won’t find its blueprint anywhere else.

Important note: fighting Great Jackal is optional, so if you don't feel strong enough to face it (or you’re following a pacifist path), you can just stay away from that ominous and dreary part of the Craggy Island and let those wolfies live in peace and keep their treasure.

[h2]Traps[/h2]

If you saw our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1967630/view/3647403465588747385?l=english]Dev Diary post on Traps[/url] recently, you know that this update also brings traps as a new method of acquiring animal resources. No more direct fighting to get those precious tendons - just prepare a bait, set a trap, and wait a bit!   

[h2]New Skills & Perks[/h2]

Survival abilities of the fourth rank are open for upgrades! Moreover, there are new survival tasks to complete, and get additional Survival Points to spend on learning them. Feel like doubling your Concentration mode radius or unlocking the Bird Potion recipe?

[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]

As always, we wish to thank you all for being a part of the development with us. Your feedback has helped shape the game and your bug reports have been invaluable in tracking down some tough-to-reproduce issues. Feel free to report any problem you encounter with the game!

notes.title: Dev Diary | Traps
notes.content:
Hello, survivors! 

[h2]Simfest is here![/h2]

Until July 24, Survival: Fountain of Youth participates in this year's Simfest, an event full of amazing sim games. It's an excellent chance to find some hidden gems of the simulation genre and add them to your library!

[h2]And now, how about some light Friday reading? [/h2]

Tired of chasing those chickens? Not confident enough to face a jaguar? With the upcoming update, we're introducing traps, an ultimate way to get animal resources without brandishing a spear and getting hurt. Although, you’ll need some patience. And a bait.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/6ef57bdf8dbe6560f58f9ec1fc96a7fd7ee16f0d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/15aafa495f77f09e28a0c97cfccd2650591011fb.png[/img]
[h2]It's a Trap![/h2]

The trap has a range. If an animal's spawn area falls within the trap's range, that animal may be trapped. There are four types of traps: the higher its tier, the more various animals it can capture, from sneaky crabs to scary pumas. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/26b47303a0999d9369c2dce9e767761f13228769.png[/img]
[h2]What are the chances?[/h2]

The chance of triggering is checked once a day and is calculated depending on various factors: the type of trap, the type of animal it is set to catch, how long ago the trap has been set, etc. The trap didn’t catch anything? Check it the next day!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/1cc56cf5739934442be878623f33374e2966f2e3.png[/img]
[h2]Don't forget the bait![/h2]

Every trap needs a certain bait to lure an animal you’re hunting for. Want to know how to catch a jackal with some petals? You catch a chicken with a couple of sage flowers, and then a jackal — with a chicken’s carcass. 

The trap is automatically marked on the map with an icon. On hover, it will also show the radius of the trap and what animal areas it covers. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/ee5c932e77568b68e27664bc6f42449b2adda43d.png[/img]
[h2]One at a time[/h2]

Catching an animal in a trap does not affect the number of animals in the area. And with no live animals around, the trap can still catch one. One more important thing: in one area, you can only catch one animal at a time, no matter how many traps are there.

The trap can only be triggered if it is not within the player's line of sight. No way to cheat the game here, even if you hide really-really well. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/d52b082e8a7ca5d380aa928ebf072fdf98cf82d6.png[/img]

We hope that you enjoyed this little guide on traps and you're eager to try them when the time comes, and it is coming already in about two weeks. If you have questions about traps, the upcoming region, or anything else, bring them in the comments!  

[i]The Survival: Fountain of Youth Team[/i]

notes.title: Dev Diary | Puma Region Sneak Peek
notes.content:
Hello, survivors!

It's been a couple of months since the game was released in Early Access and you started your journey in the world of 16th-century explorers. We know you're waiting to continue the adventures, and we've been working hard to develop the upcoming third region as soon as possible. Today’s the day for a little sneak peek of what you might expect there (including some atmospheric screenshots). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/08a3efe1599eeadf619b44c30bde7cdd56d9ce9b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/8f1defc8009c67779fe51f730e41e98fcf52f5cd.png[/img]

[b]The third region[/b] is a tough and challenging place where you'll go in the footsteps of the lost expeditions. Be prepared for various challenges whether it will be ancient puzzles, dangerous animals, unwelcoming weather conditions, or heavy-going pathways. A reward for a skillful survivor is iron deposits hidden in the depth of the Iron Island that will open numerous crafting blueprints for some of the finest items in the game. Looking forward to upgrading to a good iron axe, aren’t you?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/0f14443d92a505d143eac41ca439b52ad11267c9.png[/img]

The [b]Iron Island[/b] with inexhaustible lava streams was a home for one of the tribes before most of their homes were taken by the sea. They gathered valuable metal and coal and built impressive temples connected to the system of caves that hold great treasures. That's probably where members of your crew are camping too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/9f2d3c46b7c6dfe9b74aeba8bf868aac6942ea6b.png[/img]

Deep into the sea, over the thick fog and dangerous riffs lies the mysterious [b]Foggy Island[/b] covered with shipwreck. Some say it is impossible to leave it. Certainly, there must be something of value and rumors could be just talks of some unlucky sailors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/410cb47505319ea056b63d9ea76a202bf44e65a4.png[/img]

[b]Cliff Island[/b] is a labyrinth of rocky passages populated by hostile creatures and full of valuable resources to gather. Be as careful as you can as passes between cliffs could be deceiving and treasures could be heavily guarded.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/ac11e1bcb574a6ff31edbac09d90d0e2a999ce89.png[/img]

Are you a good sailor? To move between the islands, you’ll have to bypass all those reefs, which can be tricky. At least, be sure to stack some ship repair kits. Never too many of those.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/3082bf4467788ecb0e2851c69ff16e3b16331f4f.png[/img]

That's it for today! We hope that you are eager to experience this content that is releasing in the [b]first half of August[/b]. In a couple of weeks, we're also planning to tell you more about one of the upcoming features — traps, so stay tuned! And once again, we want to thank you for your constant support and interest in the game!

[i]The Survival: Fountain of Youth Team[/i]

notes.title: Patch 1267 | Saves Issue Fix, Balance Improvements, and More
notes.content:
Hello, survivors!

Huge thanks to everyone who has reported an issue, shared suggestions, and sent us screenshots/logs. Today’s minor update brings a number of requested fixes and tweaks to existing features. 

Please note that some of the reported issues need more time for reworking until they can be implemented, so if something is not addressed in this hotfix, it doesn't mean that we're not working on it. After today’s release, we immediately start preparing for the next patch. 

And now to the good stuff!

[h3]SAVES FIX[/h3]
Some players have encountered a very unpleasant issue with being unable to load their saves. We’re sincerely sorry about it. We took measures for this problem not to appear again. After this update, you may see this save that you had problems opening before (it will have an exclamation mark). If you click on it, the window will open with the ability to load an earlier save. Just pick the one, open it and it should work fine. 

Again, [b]we are truly sorry for this bug and the inconvenience it brought to our players[/b]. 

[h3]MAIN FIXES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Animals (most importantly, those good ol’ snakes) don’t block harvesting processes when they are too far away. But they are still able to attack if you come too close to them, so be careful. 
[*] More rocks! We added more rock piles on the island of Hope and on Copper Island. Also, you can now track them with a special marker on the resource map.
[*] It takes less time to light a fire after a failed attempt: the time of the next attempt is reduced by 60%. Burn them all!
[*] Added smaller rotation steps for layouts, so machines and buildings can be easily placed parallel to the walls of the house. We dedicate this fix for the sake of perfectionism.
[*] Carry more! The weight of all equipped items is not counted in the overall inventory weight anymore. Belts and bandoliers are now even more useful for giving those additional weight-free slots.
[*] No more accidental destruction of a flask when drinking! A confirmation pop-up is now shown when trying to destroy a flask. And you will now get resources back when disassembling coconut and bamboo flasks, as well as a charcoal pile.  
[*] Destroying a badly constructed sloped roof should not be an issue anymore.
[*] Fixed a bug with the carpentry workbench not accepting logs, if the previous process was incorrectly canceled. 
[*] The solar distiller doesn’t work at night anymore. Had to follow some physics laws here, sorry. 
[*] Tweaked the sounds the character made when receiving a sunburn status. Too much moaning, sounded a bit creepy. 
[*] Steam Cloud saves are now available. However, it is a Steam feature with some known issues, so use it cautiously. [/list]
[h3]BALANCE FIXES [/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a slot for one additional item to take from the ship on Very Easy mode 
[*] Increased carrying capacities for Hard and Very Hard modes  
[*] Fixed resources received from disassembling the mapping tower
[*] The charcoal pile is not automatically ignited after being built
[*] Fixed descriptions for islands concerning the location of certain resources (horseweed and anteaters)
[*] Tweaked damage received from falling
[*] Fixed description for the water distiller (numbers are now correct)
[*] Changed the description for harpoons (added information on the type of fish)
[*] Increased shark HP
[*] Decreased repair requirements for some items[/list]
[h3]OTHER IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed dock boundaries
[*] Added a tooltip for the gamepad on the resource-gathering page
[*] Added a check that there is no obstacle when resurrecting near a bed
[*] Numerous UX/UI improvements
[*] Numerous visual improvements
[*] Minor performance fixes
[*] Localization edits
[/list]

notes.title: Development Diaries: Statuses
notes.content:
There are several dozens of various statuses in the game. Neutral, positive and negative - all of them affect your character in a particular way, so you better keep an eye on those white/green/red icons in the upper left corner of your screen. We’ll talk about all of them.

First of all, there are statuses that primarily affect your character's vitals, so try not to forget your meal and don’t overwork yourself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/34387898ef44d7f2ccc3c799c2a4e739d044ead8.png[/img]

If you're interested in staying healthy and recovering fast, you'll want to see the green icons for 'Vivacity' and 'Natural Recovery' at all times. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/b8a58820ea84284348506358938ecef28a7987d0.png[/img]

Keep an eye on the weather, because weather conditions may have an immediate effect on your character. Is it sunny, windy or rainy? You won’t suffer from it at first, but these statuses may soon transform into other, not so pleasant ones. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/61488eb67cef203dcaa6780ce078b35336810f76.png[/img]

Aaaaand that’s what happens if you don’t take weather conditions seriously, eat not the best food and wander around Malaria swamps (what a life!). As a result of external influences, you can gain a disease status. There are several types of them with various gradations. Medicine helps prevent a disease and keeps it from progressing. Sleep and some types of food can also help. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/85457a7d0e0bebebd889d78608f522ff6404543f.png[/img]

There are also positive 'Quality sleep' and 'Health recovery' statuses that appear when your health is being restored.  

Take a minute to rest near a fire and get this nice 'By the fire' status. It will give your character full protection from the cold and pests, and helps to recover faster from damp, wind chill, and freezing, as well as to cure the flu. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/83db800c92b2dfa7e8ba1564261e8bf91d5f7e2d.png[/img]

'Overloaded' and 'Immobilized' statuses keep track of whether you are carrying too much and if you really need those four massive stones in your Inventory right now. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/03417f70f48e179dca40d1dbd4f90d912ae1f9eb.png[/img]

There is “In water’ status that may transform into ‘Drowning’ status if you forget to breathe or stay in the water for too long. There will be other signs like constantly losing stamina points and loud gurgling sounds. You won’t miss it. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/0964c9aa0ff310b9e0b8a703405de0058594f6eb.png[/img]

‘Dark’ status is pretty self-explanatory. Just light a fire or wait for the morning.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/38abc87987bffe26b146bc0b452abb766785d9ac.png[/img]

You shouldn’t stay for too long in the territories with these statuses. Better find some other places to idle.   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/aa3f4b9095fd0326883db328eab709fef1f19d96.png[/img]

Several types of medicine will give you 'Protection from pests' status to scare away spiders, scorpions and other pests. There are also several powerful potions made of Living Water, which will give you some nice statuses. Not feeling hunger/thirst/fatigue, unlimited stamina, or the ability to see animals through obstacles — if you find one of those bottles, be sure to take it with you, that may come up handy. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/647895cf8049fa23c26eba19b21e435c1e203327.png[/img]

Can’t find a dropped item or look for special objects? Don’t forget to level up your Concentration perk and press V key to gain ‘Concentration’ status allowing you to get into a special focused mode with everything interesting marked and highlighted. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/34941e7a4eb6e5b6c152a02ae20effc13832915e.png[/img]

Be sure to always keep the track of all current statuses on a separate tab (press ‘C’ key). Along with the list of all current statuses, you can also find the description of each status, its effects and recommendations on removing it, if it's negative (before it’s too late). Stay safe!

notes.title: Development Diaries: Rainy Island
notes.content:
Survival: Fountain of Youth attempts to provide the surviving experience in various conditions. Prepare to get wet, because in the course of following the story, you'll have to visit the Rainy Island. We'll talk a bit about what to expect there. 

[i]Please, note that this island is not available in the demo.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/7ef4bbfc6e88c43147cc5f18ebf5fc370a8db96f.png[/img]

There is not a lot of land to explore, though it will take time to get around due to difficult conditions and dangerous animals. Boars are expecting you, so prepare to fight a lot. Or crawl, if you prefer peaceful ways of dealing with things. 

By the way, Rainy Island is the place where you’ll find a clay deposit, and clay is used for crafting really nice things. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/d5c625f12fd47c6b0ce7237cb12a797ecfcf4a36.png[/img]

You can also find precious mold, a very useful substance that can be used to cure all types of diseases. Beware of crocodiles though.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/9facb00d79e933848ec1a39ac15b156b310861b9.png[/img]

Rainy Island is an essential point to progress through the storyline. There you will get some important information and will learn what to do next. A spooky skeleton included. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/f28aad0bfb0788b802b298bb75cc96ef73a31c6d.png[/img]

Perfect weather, but not when you're outside. Prepare to get wet!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/50cb32a2d3a84271ce1ef5e7d67b7e0b897123f2.png[/img]

Stay tuned for more information on the game features and content!

notes.title: Development Diaries: Staying hydrated
notes.content:
Surviving is difficult, to say the very least. You want to make sure that all your basic needs are covered, with the most important of them being to satisfy your thirst. While collecting each and every green coconut you see is still useful, you may want to check some other ways of providing yourself with liquid. 

[i]Please, note that some of these ways are not available in the demo.[/i]

Water storages can be found in the area - they were carefully built by someone beforehand. They collect water when it's raining, so the faster you get to a water storage after a good rain, the less precious water will have time to evaporate from it. And don't forget to bring a couple of flasks with you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/586e0daf80a4d19317be6a1a472b90974dcf2018.png[/img]

Sometimes you have to take things in your own hands and start crafting. Wooden and clay rainwater collectors are something you can make yourself, so you won't have to wander dangerous territories in search of a water storage. They look nice and are able to collect 15 and 40 units of rain water, respectively. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/d0f1e89aaedc48358fd08ada7adda5ad61bb7865.png[/img]

When you improve your crafting skills enough, you may want to build a water distiller. Just pour some saltwater into it, light the fire and start waiting while saltwater will gradually evaporate and condense into freshwater. In the meantime, you may entertain yourself by watching the occasional water drop falling down from the pipe (no one will judge you for not doing something useful, that's one of the perks of living on a desert island).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/421fc3a97f5d773a9f4d40de613da3adb3898ad0.png[/img]

Solar water distiller has the same mechanism, though it uses solar heat and doesn't require fuel. However it only works during the day and when it's located under the sun - the sunnier the weather, the higher the productivity. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/ee1896293e2c91cbb5c9f2a99b059732fbeef1be.png[/img]

There is also a nice thing called Palm juice collector that can be placed on a date palm and store up to 5 units of juice. Not really water, but will increase your water stat anyway. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/7fd11b3f00c8097581466e32712da15ec42ef1e2.png[/img]

Always keep track of your water stat - there are still plenty of other ways to die! 



Stay tuned for more information on the game features and content!

notes.title: Development Diaries: Equipment sets
notes.content:
Hello, survivors! We are excited to cover more content already prepared for you in Survival: Fountain of Youth. Today, we’ll talk about all sets of equipment available in the game, what they are made of and their characteristics. So, check information below to know the latest fashion trends in Survival: Fountain of Youth!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/26d743074913586d075ff0c6ffc0e7f5864d046c.png[/img]

[h3]Leaf set [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/09fd37d18bced3e5934d996ed2acb8dec86c9d30.png[/img]

Leaf set consists of a hat, cape, skirt and sandals. It’s the first equipment available for the player and increases protection from the sun. It’s easy to craft and repair, since it’s made of wide and narrow leaves, which can be easily found in most places. 

[h3]Animal hide set[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/b4779c1d1670ebcd75108f34c1415a90ee1790ae.png[/img]

Animal hide set consists of a hat, cape, pants and shoes. It increases sun and rain protection, but to craft it, first you’ll need to master your hunting skills and gather some fresh hides and animal tendons.

[h3]Seaweed set[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/04ac2c8e6c009ba86f6faa05e0ccf48724093220.png[/img]

To make a seaweed hat, poncho, shorts and sandals, you’ll need to collect some algae that grow underwater and make seaweed fabric. The seaweed set not only provides sun, rain and heat protection, but also gives the character some armor units and decreases damage from animals. 

[h3]Leather set[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/8a5f5cfb7791b933d9b6dc5629f2d6564b208c92.png[/img]

Leather hood, jacket, pants and boots will increase the character’s protection from sun, rain, wind and heat, while also providing some armor points and protection from animals’ attacks. 

[h3]Linen set[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/953439134b4dd3c3185e08913d67f62ea4a5d22e.png[/img]

Flax, specifically, linen fabric will allow you to craft the linen set, consisting of a hood, linothorax, pants and boots. Compared to the previous set, it will give the character more armor points and also protect from cold.  

[h3]Leather set with copper plates[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/6926dfbc37604f11eb63014e76bf38d2256e5d29.png[/img]

Each item from the basic leather set can be improved by adding copper ingots, greatly increasing armor points given to the character. 

[h3]Linen set with iron [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/49e11d4c919b62f44fcaf8b872c6d12c2dc5f810.png[/img]

The best set of armor in the game is made of a basic linen set and iron ingots. It increases protection from all negative statuses in the game (sun, rain, wind, cold and heat), gives the maximum of armor points and decreases the damage from animal attacks. 

Hope you enjoyed this introduction guide to the fashion in Survival: Fountain of Youth! Stay tuned for more information on the game features and content!

notes.title: Development Diaries: House building
notes.content:
Hello, survivors! We are excited to share with you the news on the feature we’ve been working on for the past few months. No more sleeping and crafting under the open sky - you'll have the ability to build a proper house with walls made of sticks and a roof. Like this. Nice, isn’t it?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/1c340e1490ffc952ef5531a21bf4d0665ef29c17.png[/img]

All blueprints associated with the house building will be located in the 'House' crafting category. They will be opened the same as all other blueprints - after finding one of the essential resources.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/edac2e8bbe0f09ee53843c6ac8769df6d8a3b28f.png[/img]

The whole building process consists of placing basic elements and attaching them to each other. Foundation, floor, walls, roofs, ladders, stairs - you’ll be able to build a house of any size and design, with multiple levels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/7ab90067e795bf54b35d910aff75b36c8812de53.png[/img]

In addition to the feeling of comfort and security, all basic houses will protect you from wind, rain and sun. Improved houses will also provide protection from the cold. By the way, animals will not be able to enter a house as well

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/4d252852b2af5d91acf89747b2ad09d5367918b2.png[/img]

Hope you are excited about the upcoming feature. We’ll be sharing more information as the developing process keeps going. Stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/df6fb15003f07f4c6d91d8891b754d9a529787ce.png[/img]

notes.title: Development Diaries: Hot Island
notes.content:
Hello, survivors! Today we reveal information on one more island that is not available in the demo, with the previous ones being Crocodile Island and Windy Island. So, welcome to Hot Island, a small piece of land, which may not seem particularly hospitable, but will be an important part of the journey in the Survival: Fountain of Youth world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/00acc75e7715216f4351cebf200300c7980346e1.png[/img]

Though small, the island can offer some rare resources, including aloe, agave and cassava trees. Their fruits are edible and can also be used for some complex medicine recipes.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/8f245a51ea5ea24d483961f1ad81716dca26db59.png[/img]

Get ready to use your weapons, because the island is also the home of tegus - fast and unpleasant opponents, which can be good sources of bones, animal fat and fresh hides.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/bd4169512e4a57030bebadd3fc0c16a1ac77766c.png[/img]

On the island, there is an ancient drawing, revealing some details of the history of these lands and the people living on them. You can also find a piece of a very useful blueprint there (no spoilers though!).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/bb347a5bf47e2f82f4cee8e1a8be4c2a3f51db99.png[/img]

There is not much food here, but you can find a fishing spot, so be sure to bring a solid fishing rod with you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/21179e8b0dd15a8d34c27c56ae895ebe8c25b992.png[/img]

Be sure to wishlist the game in order not to miss further news and interesting announcements!

notes.title: Patch #8
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

Another update for the demo is ready, introducing some important gameplay improvements, as well as balance and localization fixes. We really appreciate all your feedback helping us to develop the game and making it an enjoyable experience for everyone. 

[list]
[*] Changed the starting location on the Island of Hope. Now it is more spacious and suitable for building a long-term camp. We also increased the number of basic resources there including small sticks and stones. 
[b][i]Note: if you had any buildings/items located within this area before the patch, they may conflict with the new surroundings. Unfortunately, the only solution in this case would be to rebuild them.[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/ba769226e8f1943dc356bd27bee269cb574c2a83.png[/img]
[*] Now there are ten items from which to choose at the prologue, we also added an Improved Fishing Rod. Living Water was replaced with a medical kit that includes Clay and Egg Ointment to heal wounds, Powder from Snakes and Spiders to treat all forms of poisoning, Sweating Potion to treat flu and Coral Powder that restores health points. Pistol now has 25 bullets (instead of 10).
[*] Balanced sailing on the global map. Changed the speed of time, vitals declining, as well as clothes degrading when sailing, so now traveling between islands should feel more pleasant.
[*] You can now roast short-eared dogs’ carcasses and eat them. Short-eared dogs don’t drop resources anymore. 
[*] The player marker on the map is now displayed even if the player is in a territory they have not mapped beforehand, so following the map is much easier now.
[*] Water doesn't completely evaporate in water sources (they are called water storages now), so there will always be at least several drops of water left when you come to it.
[*] Added visual tips appearing on the screen when a player receives their first injury, experiences the first illness or worsening of the disease, etc. We hope that this feature will help players understand and learn how the game works.
[*] You can’t catch Malaria or receive a cold effect on the Island of Hope now. 
[*] Increased borders around the islands, so now you can go further distances from the shore without switching to the global map.
[*] Changed the animation of Smoke Signal, now it looks more natural.
[*] Added coral reefs near the Island of Hope.
[*] Numerous balance and localization fixes.
[/list]
Thank you for your interest in the game and support. We look forward to sharing more information about future patches and game news.

notes.title: Development Diaries: Windy Island
notes.content:
Hello, survivors! Today we reveal one more island located in the Survival: Fountain of Youth world. Welcome to Windy Island, a relatively small piece of land covered with sand and some palm trees.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/5026d87bb24f71c7654cee532294f078e301b333.png[/img]

Although the island is not very large, it is possible to find rare resources on it, including aloe and agave. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/8af458e4a6504ed4c291d170bf8c7fa20f7c7521.png[/img]

Walking in search of rare resources, do not forget the jackals always looking for prey in the face of a lonely wandering traveler.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/b98d176768faea1c5d44bca9e6cbaf5f55874a37.png[/img]

Visiting the island is one of the essential steps to progress through the story of the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/ce4101db90e52f0d372e2666e3d96fe74086c363.png[/img]

Windy Island may be a challenging place for surviving. The wind has some negative effects, including the blocking of natural recovery or quality sleep. It is also quite hot there, which is one more thing to keep in mind. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/34dea0f3dce4e238967adb4f9f2928cfa98de063.png[/img]

But the island is definitely worth visiting, at least, to observe those magical sunrises, don't you think? Just don't forget to bring a fishing rod. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/72faf05db9a0125e7179debe2c292b7a6364fa71.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch #7
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

Another update for the demo is ready, featuring a new island to explore, new storm mechanics, and some other minor changes. We know that by now some of you have probably explored each and every corner of the Island of Hope, so we decided to add some content to encourage you to sail and explore the global map a bit more.

Welcome to Coconut Island! It’s a relatively small island full of coconut palms, hence the name. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/11756689f788b800408de519c0663af2a4032ca5.png[/img]

Crabs, fish and tons of coconuts — at least, hunger won’t be an issue there. You can also find some rare resources like Agave and Aloe on the island. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/0d5fbf2e8cc76ac8d7b57efa8bdd779bf1a6b207.png[/img]

On the island, there is an ancient drawing revealing some details of the history of these territories. And some short-eared dogs that you like so much. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/03797bbcfa373eaf0fbd4b9e1b9f469eec8669dc.png[/img]

One more important part of this patch is Storms. Now, while sailing on the global map, you can get caught in a storm. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/26eaf99b97cc3545fa833c2670e2a51434c66943.png[/img]

Your main goal is to follow the marker, navigate between rocks and get out without completely wrecking your vessel. It’s not an easy task, so prepare to test your sailing skills. You may also remain at your initial location and wait it out, but this way you won’t receive any experience when the storm ends. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/b12f11a4453534fce62303f1507da0b7242eb474.png[/img]

There is also one more important alteration. We are reworking the global map, so there have been some changes and Santa Maria is now located to the right from Lonely Rock. 

That’s all for now, hope you’ll enjoy today’s patch! Please remember to contact us if you encounter any issues while playing the game.

notes.title: Development Diaries: Crocodile Island
notes.content:
Hello, survivors! By now you have probably explored each remote corner of the Island of Hope and you are wondering what other locations are waiting for you in the game. We'd like to shed some light on it. So, how about some sneak peak of a Crocodile Island. Can you guess what its distinguishing feature is? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/d0ffdd548b907d0de0ef8b03e8771bc9fb2149f6.png[/img]

Crocodile Island is a medium-sized piece of land covered with jungle. There are large dangerous animals, primarily crocodiles, but also some boars, short eared dogs and frogs, so you’ll need some spears and the skill to accurately throw them. By the way, crocodiles may hide in the water, so you’ll need to be particularly careful when exploring the island.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/4191afbc80505c717d1f4b2c22c1f71f69d19a74.png[/img]

In the center of the island there is a swamp where there is a high chance of catching malaria. You can also find an important object for further progress in the story somewhere in the middle of it. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/036029ee10d58452a8c74e5dae4a47d7c67aed46.png[/img]

The island is suitable for the construction of a long-term camp. Palm trees grow on the shore, several types of rare crafting resources can also be found there, including clay and mold.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/869eeb7b20d0d078d1fd6142917bf4377a616e82.png[/img]

Crocodile Island is one of 20 islands in the game with its unique biome and character. Are you waiting to visit it? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291243/49b0f050360311499544212d14ba5771d7d53421.png[/img]

notes.title: Playtest Patch #4
notes.content:
Hello survivors!

We have released a hotfix for reported issues. This patch includes bug fixes and some quality of life improvements. Check them below! 

1. First of all, we fixed the bug when axes, spears, arrows and other weapons got stuck in animals and objects, fell through the ground or just disappeared. If something like that happens again and you can't find your weapon, try relaunching the game and looking around for it.

2. Added stability to the character on the Cartographer's tree. Falling from there is still possible, so be careful, but now you shouldn't be able to slip and fall while mapping.

3. Some primitive weapons used to disappear when completely losing durability. Now, all weapons are automatically put in the inventory and can't be put back into active slots when their durability is reduced to zero.  

4. Reduced the time of resource gathering from fish and several other objects.

5. Added the recipe to cure Malaria that you can catch in the swamps.

6. Fixed raining in the grotto. 

7. Fixed rocks around the Cartographer's tree, in which your dropped bag could get stuck after you faint.

8. Scaled the previews of some objects in the inventory that were too small.

9. For the sake of accuracy, Clamshells were renamed to Conch shells, and Turtles - to Tortoises.

10. Animal skeletons no longer bleed when hit. 

11. Improved FPS performance in the jungle.

12. Multiple minor fixes and improvements.

Also, if you experience issues with buildings on the rafts made before the latest patch, try relaunching the game. If that doesn’t help, unfortunately, the only solution is to build a new raft. 

Thank you for your patience and support. Please remember to contact us if you encounter any issues while playing the game.
